A Historic Moment for the DMV Community

A remarkable new landmark is taking shape in the Washington, DC area — a Shikharbaddh BAPS Mandir and Spiritual & Cultural Complex that will celebrate India's rich spiritual and cultural heritage and create a place for reflection, learning, art, education, and community connection.

This is more than the construction of a mandir. It is an opportunity to preserve and share timeless values, Vedic art and architecture, Indian traditions, and a spirit of service with future generations and with the broader community.

We warmly invite you, your family, and friends to join us for the Bhumi Pujan Vidhi on Sunday, October 11, 2026, from 4:00–6:30 PM at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Beltsville, Maryland.

Come witness the beginning of a landmark that is envisioned to serve and inspire the community for generations to come.

Be there. Be part of history. Be part of the foundation of something that will last for centuries.

Sunday, October 11, 2026 | 4:00–6:30 PM
BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir
4320 Ammendale Rd, Beltsville, MD 20705

Everyone is warmly welcome.

From the flyer:

Importance of a BAPS Spiritual Complex
BAPS complexes serve as vital spiritual sanctuaries, offering inner peace and reflection in a fast-paced world while also serving as living monuments that preserve Vedic art, architecture, and rich Hindu traditions. Through this accessible heritage, these centers foster fundamental principles like family harmony, moral purity, humility, and the spirit of selfless service (seva).

A True Gift to Society
This new BAPS spiritual complex will beautify the local landscape, uplift communities, and provide a welcoming space for cultural exchange, art, and education. It will serve as a living bridge between traditions, preserving rich cultural heritage while inviting the broader public to experience its artistic expressions.

A Once-in-a-Lifetime Opportunity
We stand at the threshold of history. A monumental new BAPS spiritual complex project is about to begin right here. Being part of this project is not just about helping construct a physical building; it is about laying the foundation for a legacy that will inspire and elevate humanity for centuries to come.
